description: Window controls for the frameless custom titlebar (milestone 36, DESIGN §Surface 1 region 1): the data-tauri-drag-region needs core:window:start_dragging, and double-click-to-maximize needs the maximize/unmaximize core commands. The bespoke minimize/maximize/hide-to-tray buttons route through the app's OWN #[tauri::command] handlers (Rust does the window op), so they need no core-window grant; only the Tauri-injected drag handler does.
